note: Each record is one payer's word about one paid call, tied to a payment ARP read on its own chain when this file was built. It proves the payment and who made it, not what the endpoint delivered. by_endpoint counts a record only when a reading of the endpoint's own 402 named its payee and price (payee_check); the others are counted as unchecked. ARP's own ranking counts an outcome only once 3 distinct wallets say it (ADR 0143); this feed lists every record and leaves the counting to the reader.
